items.title: 新增 ERC：WeissChannels，ERC-4337 账户的跨链执行
items.note: （eil-docbot）提交：为 4337 智能账户提供单签名、原子、无托管的跨链执行，使用由 L1 乐观担保的临时状态通道。
items.title_en: Add ERC: WeissChannels, cross chain execution for ERC-4337 accounts
items.note_en: (eil-docbot), submitted: single signature, atomic, non custodial cross chain execution for 4337 smart accounts, using ephemeral just in time state channels secured optimistically by L1.

WeissChannels cross chain execution for ERC-4337 accounts
a cross chain function calls via hooks ERC merged
summary_en: drakefjustin announced an inflection in the EF's long term quantum strategy: a new post-quantum team led by tcoratger, joined by Emile from the leanVM core team. eil-docbot submitted a cross chain execution ERC for ERC-4337 accounts (WeissChannels), with atomic cross chain execution from one signature. poojaranjan submitted the BPO1 and BPO2 hardfork meta EIPs.
